source: ollizfx v3 (note 87 ; graphiques abstraits « sans tendance haussière », carnet, atelier vu de dos), exco v2 (cabinets comptables, personnes fictives), brasserieassur (assurance : l'outil de production, jamais la consommation), dbl-avocat (documents vierges).
style: Cinematic editorial photograph, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, fine 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, calm and serious, modern premium magazine look.
interdits: No numbers, no prices, no currency symbols, no upward trend, no gold coins, no banknotes, no piggy bank, no stock-photo handshake, no readable chart, no recognizable face.
evite: Évite toute promesse de gain (ollizfx exige « no upward trend ») et les clichés d'argent : graphiques abstraits sans chiffres, carnets, bureaux calmes.

404.consigne: A closed notebook and a pencil on an empty desk, a calculator with a blank display beside it, soft morning light, calm and tidy, a gentle touch of humour.
404.evite: Le chiffre rouge ou la perte.

ouverture.consigne: A dark desk at night with {sujet}, two monitors showing abstract grids of coloured tiles and a sideways choppy line with a dashed horizontal line, no upward trend, no numbers, no labels, a notebook and a pencil in the foreground, nobody.
ouverture.evite: La courbe qui monte, perçue comme une promesse.

section-fond.consigne: A neat stack of bound printed reports on a desk, the top one open showing abstract bars and smooth curves in soft ink with no numbers and no words, paper texture, {lumiere}.

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of a hand holding a pencil above an open notebook with a checklist of empty boxes and a few ticked boxes, no readable words, {sujet} beside it, warm desk-lamp light, the person not visible beyond the hand.
scene-metier.evite: Le relevé bancaire ou le bilan lisible.

lieu.consigne: Bright open-plan office with wooden desks and large windows, two or three people working seen from behind or in soft motion blur so no face is visible, morning light, calm and friendly atmosphere.
lieu.evite: Les visages fictifs « étranges » qu'exco v2 relançait.

texture.consigne: Macro photograph of {matieres}, perfectly even soft lighting, seamless texture filling the whole frame, no objects, no numbers.

portrait-generique.consigne: Small group seen from behind and slightly out of focus, facing a large wall screen with an abstract sideways chart and a dashed horizontal line, no upward trend, no numbers, a tall window, no faces.
